g.text: Measured budget curves from the same checkpoint
Each backbone uses one checkpoint and all 8 measured T/D/S settings; each curve changes T only (384 -> 768).
Segments connect observations; no fitted or extrapolated points. Green brackets compare measured FLOPs, not runtime speed.
